idea-plugin.name: Memory Layout
idea-plugin.description:
Shows how a C# type resides in memory: every field with its offset and size, and the padding bytes between them, the way the C++ memory layout view does.

Right-click a type in the editor and pick Memory Layout. Nested structs expand in place with absolute offsets; the header says how big the type is, how it is aligned, how much of it is padding, and whether it can be blitted.

Nothing runs and no debugger is needed: the layout is computed from the source text.

action.description: Show how the type under the caret sits in memory
